card.title: 25. PANZERGRENADIER
card.text: Gets Guard when it moves into the frontline.
card.flavorText: The 25th Panzergrenadier Regiment was originally part of the 2nd Infantry Division of the Wehrmacht that participated in the invasion of Poland and France. The division was reorganized as a panzer division in 1940 and renamed to 12th Panzer Division. In 1941 the division participated in Operation Barbarossa and fought in several battles and campaigns on the Eastern Front. The division participated in the Siege of Leningrad, the Battle of Kursk and finally it surrendered to the Red Army in the Courland Pocket in 1945.
